transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
Lately, I've been struggling with these intense thoughts and beliefs that other people keep telling me aren't real. It feels like I'm uncovering secrets about how the world works
Can you tell me more about these secrets you're uncovering? What do you believe is happening?

I’ve noticed that billboards and TV broadcasts have hidden messages specifically meant for me to decode. I believe I've been chosen for a special mission because of my unique abilities, and these signs are guiding me on what to do next.
Have you been feeling unusually energized, elevated, or irritable lately, or had periods of low mood?

Yes, I've been feeling incredibly energized and happy lately, like I have an endless amount of vitality to get things done. I do get quite irritable when others try to slow me down or don't keep up, but I definitely haven't experienced any low moods or sadness at all.
Have these unusual beliefs and experiences been happening only during times when you've felt this elevated energy and mood, or have they also occurred when your mood was stable?

Most of the time, they do happen when I'm feeling really energized and high. But there have definitely been times, like for a couple of weeks or so, where my mood felt completely normal and stable, but I was still seeing those messages and signs.
During the times when your mood was stable, how long did the experiences with the messages and signs last without any mood symptoms?

During those times when my mood felt completely normal and stable, the experiences with the signs and messages still continued on their own. They lasted like that for about two to three weeks without any of the high energy.
In total, how long have you been experiencing these messages and signs, even when your mood was stable?

Yes, I've definitely experienced those signs and messages during my stable periods, and those times usually lasted for about two weeks. In total, this whole experience has been going on for about two years

During the past two years, how long in total have you had these experiences with messages and signs when your mood was stable—specifically, have they occurred for at least two weeks at a time, and cumulatively for more than a month?

Yes, they have definitely occurred for at least two weeks at a time without any high energy or elevated mood. Over the last two years, those stable periods have happened multiple times, so in total it has been much longer than a month. The messages and signs just kept happening even when I felt completely normal.
